title: Deconfliction line used before strike on Russian proxies in Syria

tellings.quote: Russians through their proxies uh proxy militias attacked a bunch of Americans in Syria and we called them on the deconfliction line

plain: After Russian-backed militias attacked Americans in Syria, the United States first called Russia on the deconfliction line, a direct channel the two militaries use to avoid clashing by accident, before striking back. Bob Maguire, a former CIA contractor, tells Michels this, passing on what he was told: "we called them on the deconfliction line." He tells it to show how the two powers talk to each other even in a fight.
